decisions.reason: Core resin injection unit is a low-cost option with unresolved market potential, so keep it open.
Second resin injection unit overlaps somewhat but remains an inexpensive option to hedge specification preferences, so keep.
Automatic airless spray gun fits core spraying technology and has no negative signals, so keep as an option.
Manual airless spray gun is a low-cost option in a core segment, so keep.
Air-assisted airless spray gun is another core spraying option with unresolved value, so keep.
Data logger is complementary but less central; still cheap to maintain as an option, so keep.
